quote: We emulate the Round 2 annotation setting in §3.2 as closely as possible by prompting each model to provide a score reflecting how much each Round 1 explanation makes sense for a given label.
methods: providing a probability that the reason makes sense for the label

quote: We collect annotations from four annotators on 500 NLI items randomly sampled from the MNLI subset of ChaosNLI.
guideline: Annotators were asked to provide not only one or more NLI labels (E: Entailment, N: Neutral, C: Contradiction) to each item but also a one-sentence explanation for each label they chose.
criteria: makes sense for the NLI label
